description: Date annotations inserted in each 6-turn window before ingestion (configuration A). Windows are the ones preprocess.py builds from locomo10.json (session, part, first turn id); 'offset' is the character position in that window text where 'text' was inserted, in order, so the ingested window can be rebuilt exactly. Windows with status 'unchanged' or 'rejected: ...' were ingested as built.
